title: Discover Banff National Park - Premium Day Trip
includes: Front door pick-up and drop-off at most hotels in Calgary and Canmore
Activities: canoe rentals, gondola tickets, etc (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Great stops with time to explore, hike or canoe at Lake Louise! Plus, front door pick-up and drop-off.

Main stops: Lake Louise (1.5 to 2 hours depending on season), Town of Banff, Lake Minnewanka, Two Jack Lake, Moraine Lake (June 1st to October 11th) and Mont Norquay Lookout (Until May 31st we then replace stop with Moraine Lake).

Wow‑moments all day long — from wildlife sightings to trains in the valley to those unexpected Rockies surprises that make the day unforgettable.

10–12 hour full‑day adventure — designed so you can check off your mountain bucket list in one unforgettable day.

Small groups, big comfort — avoid crowded shuttle buses and enjoy a relaxed, unscripted day with a welcoming Alberta vibe.

By the end of the day, you’ll feel like you’ve spent the day with people you’ve known for years.

Departing from Calgary and Canmore, good vibes, great moments, and the Canadian Rockies ready to welcome you year‑round.
